input: Join /data/employees.csv and /data/departments.csv on the department_id field. Produce /data/report.csv with columns: name, department_name, salary. Include a header row. Print the result.

transcript.final_response:
I joined the two files on `department_id` and wrote the result to `/data/report.csv`:

```
name,department_name,salary
Alice,Engineering,120000
Bob,Marketing,95000
Carol,Engineering,115000
Dave,Sales,88000
Eve,Marketing,92000
```

All five employees matched a department. The output follows the order of `employees.csv`.
tool_calls: cd /data; cat -A employees.csv | tail -3; awk -F, 'NR==FNR{if(FNR>1)d[$1]=$2;next} FNR==1{print "name,department_name,salary";next} {print $1","d[$2]","$3}' <(tr -d '\r' <departments.csv) <(tr -d '\r' <employees.csv) > report.csv; cat report.csv
